Natural Stone for London Gardens and Exterior Spaces

Marla Stone works with natural stone for London gardens, terraces, patios and exterior residential spaces. The service can include garden paving, limestone steps, travertine terraces, outdoor stone tiles, threshold details, wall coping and exterior stone features.

Exterior stone needs to be selected with care. The material must suit the architecture, the level of foot traffic, the weather exposure, the required finish and the way the outdoor space connects back to the interior.

Garden Paving, Terraces and Patios

Natural stone paving can bring texture, permanence and architectural clarity to an outdoor space. We work with materials such as limestone, travertine, granite and selected exterior-grade natural stones for garden terraces, patios, pathways and outdoor floor areas.

The layout is planned around slab size, joint width, finish, drainage, thresholds and how the stone meets planting, steps, walls, doors and interior flooring.

Limestone Steps and Bullnose Details

Steps are one of the most important details in an exterior stone project. Limestone steps, bullnose edges, landing slabs and garden transitions need to be practical, durable and visually aligned with the wider design.

Marla Stone can advise on stone thickness, edge profiles, slip resistance, finish, joint lines and how the steps connect with terraces, garden levels and entrance points.

Travertine, Limestone and Exterior Stone Selection

The right material depends on the outdoor setting. Travertine can bring warmth and texture to terraces and garden areas. Limestone works well for softer architectural schemes, heritage-led homes and calm neutral exteriors. Granite can be useful where a harder-wearing stone is required.

Through slab selection and material guidance, we help clients and designers compare colour, texture, finish, porosity, maintenance and suitability for exterior use before fabrication or installation begins.

Interior-to-Exterior Stone Transitions

Many London homes use natural stone to connect interior and exterior spaces. A limestone floor may continue towards a garden room, terrace or threshold. A stone step detail may need to align with internal flooring, exterior paving and door levels.

We consider these transitions early, so the stone feels consistent across the project rather than treated as a separate outdoor finish.

Exterior Fabrication and Installation Detail

Exterior stone installation requires planning around substrate preparation, falls, drainage, movement, fixing, edge protection and long-term weathering. These details are especially important for garden paving, terraces, steps and exterior thresholds.

For London residential projects, Marla Stone focuses on material suitability, clean detailing and specialist installation, creating exterior stonework that feels durable, architectural and connected to the home.

Garden Rooms, Conservatories and Pavilions

Where a garden project includes a structure as well as stonework, our sister company Marla Garden designs bespoke steel-and-glass conservatories, garden rooms, pavilions and glasshouses, so terraces, steps and thresholds can be planned together with the building they lead to.

Related Stone Materials

Relevant materials include limestone, travertine, granite, Portland Stone, Silver Travertine and Deep Green Marble.
